name: Plaza Deli
notes: 2 photos of the same printed order-by-number counter menu, one wider shot (sandwiches/favorites/fresh salads) and one closer shot adding breakfast specials/omelettes/toasted bagels. Several sandwich prices are grouped under one printed price for a numbered block rather than shown per line, so those were carried down from the nearest visible price; additions/sides (a la carte modifiers) were skipped per the extraction rules. Angus Beef Burger has no visible price and was left unpriced.
